families.name: Unit and component contract pytest
families.purpose: Protect local deterministic contracts across game subsystems.
families.approximate_case_count: Most of 6,433 collected cases; boundaries overlap named families.
families.origin: Multiple eras; retained through Architecture Reconciliation
families.test_doubles: fixtures, monkeypatches, temporary stores, controlled responses
families.pass_meaning: Selected assertions hold under their fixture boundary.
families.fail_meaning: A local contract, fixture, or expectation diverged; cause requires triage.
families.ci_status: Broad suite exists; current full suite is red.
families.gates: Intended broad regression gate, presently unable to provide a green release signal.
families.reliability_issues: Family label is too broad for semantic claims; extensive implementation coupling in some clusters.
families.human_review: Only for disputed requirement or failure triage.
families.evidence_standard: Not normally; apply to behavioral claims only.
families.health: Mixed: large green majority with 49 failures distributed across narrower families.
families.rationale: Core deterministic protection remains essential, but its PASS must remain assertion-scoped.

families.name: API and turn-pipeline integration
families.purpose: Verify in-process HTTP, persistence, routing, and turn-pipeline wiring.
families.runtime_path: Real in-process FastAPI routes, usually temporary state
families.test_doubles: patched model, parsers, clocks, retry paths, temporary persistence
families.pass_meaning: Controlled requests traverse selected production integration paths.
families.fail_meaning: Wiring, state, response contract, or controlled behavior diverged.
families.reliability_issues: Stubbed GM output cannot support semantic authority.
families.evidence_standard: Only when used to support a player-facing behavioral claim.
families.rationale: Unique production-wiring evidence is valuable when semantic claims are excluded.

families.name: Final-emission validation and metadata contracts
families.purpose: Protect player-facing emission structure, ownership metadata, fallback routing, and repair boundaries.
families.runtime_path: Production final-emission stack with controlled payloads
families.test_doubles: constructed payloads and patched adjacent layers
families.pass_meaning: Enumerated emission invariants and metadata contracts hold.
families.fail_meaning: Current behavior, ownership policy, compatibility expectation, or snapshot diverged.
families.reliability_issues: High fanout and historical compatibility aliases make intended authority difficult to separate from transitional detail.
families.evidence_standard: Required only when asserting semantic quality.
families.health: Current product NameError plus stale/governance expectations are present.
families.rationale: Purpose is essential, but contract ownership and compatibility-era assertions need a bounded modernization.
families.preserved_purpose: Player-facing emission safety, authoritative ownership metadata, and fallback/repair boundaries.

families.name: Controlled structural protected replay CI lane
families.purpose: Protect selected structural gameplay-path invariants through the in-process pipeline without claiming production-model semantics.
families.test_doubles: fixed GM responses and seeded temporary worlds
families.pass_meaning: Protected structural route/emission invariants hold under controlled GM input; no production-model semantic claim is established.
families.fail_meaning: Protected runtime structure or its projection diverged.
families.ci_status: Explicit blocking controlled-structural CI marker lane
families.reliability_issues: Historical golden/live terminology could imply semantic/model authority that the lane does not possess.
families.human_review: Review changes to protected invariant set.
families.evidence_standard: Not for structural PASS; required if behavioral claims are attached.
families.health: Claim reclassification implemented; marker count drift remains an unrelated current failure.
families.rationale: Retain the gate but name/report it explicitly as controlled structural replay, not semantic golden quality.
families.implementation_notes: CI presentation and current governance docs now state controlled structural authority; marker selection, assertions, and hard-fail behavior are unchanged.

families.name: Replay projection, recurrence, drift, and failure diagnostics
families.purpose: Project runtime observations and diagnose recurrence, ownership drift, and failure families.
families.runtime_path: Projected observations, histories, and controlled replay payloads
families.pass_meaning: Projection and diagnostic registries match current expected shapes.
families.fail_meaning: Runtime contract, projection snapshot, registry, or historical report diverged.
families.ci_status: Mixed into broad suite; many current failures
families.reliability_issues: Diagnostic projections and generated histories have acquired gate-like authority; snapshot churn is high.
families.human_review: Required before selecting the small authoritative subset.
families.evidence_standard: Useful provenance support, not behavioral authority.
families.health: Substantial drift and byte-for-byte projection failures.
families.rationale: Keep unique recurrence diagnostics, but consolidate authoritative invariants into protected replay and final-emission owner contracts.
families.surviving_authority: GOLDEN_PROTECTED_REPLAY for protected runtime invariants and FINAL_EMISSION_CONTRACTS for owner contracts.
families.evidence_loss_risk: Trend and recurrence visibility could be lost if historical diagnostics are removed before equivalent reports are identified.

families.name: Playability evaluator and runtime runner
families.purpose: Run short fixed scripts through /api/chat and score four heuristic axes.
families.approximate_case_count: Small scenario set plus evaluator/smoke tests
families.runtime_path: Real API and configured runtime in CLI; controlled runtime in tests
families.ai_output: real/configured in CLI, stubbed in tests
families.test_doubles: smoke tests patch model and adjacent parsing
families.evidence: transcripts, evaluation, debug, metadata, state snapshots
families.pass_meaning: Final-turn aggregate heuristic threshold and minimum immersion were met; this is supporting evidence, not independent player-facing acceptance.
families.fail_meaning: Threshold, dead-turn, or infrastructure rule failed; not necessarily product invalidity.
families.ci_status: Tests in suite; live runner is campaign-operated
families.gates: Mandatory evaluator failures remain signals; PASS does not independently close a player-facing campaign
families.reliability_issues: Demonstrated false confidence, compensatory scoring, final-turn focus, and evaluator disagreements.
families.human_review: Required for consequential semantic claims and disagreements.
families.health: Operational as supporting evidence; execution, thresholds, and mandatory gates are unchanged.
families.rationale: Retain as evidence generator/evaluator signal, but remove sole semantic authority until calibration supports promotion.
families.implementation_notes: Current docs and authority metadata now classify PASS as supporting evidence; evaluator and runner behavior are unchanged.
families.audit_recommendation: RECLASSIFY from CAMPAIGN_GATE to SUPPORTING_EVIDENCE at HIGH confidence.

families.name: Scenario-spine long-session validation
families.purpose: Exercise predetermined multi-turn branches and evaluate continuity/session-health heuristics.
families.approximate_case_count: Scripted branch fixtures plus extensive evaluator tests
families.runtime_path: Real /api/chat or configured server with reset persisted state
families.test_doubles: test fixtures and controlled branch data
families.evidence: branch transcripts, evaluations, debug and aggregate reports
families.pass_meaning: Fixed branches avoided enumerated failures; warning also counts as overall passed.
families.fail_meaning: A scripted branch violated scoring/classification rules.
families.ci_status: Tooling/tests exist; no universal live gate
families.reliability_issues: Fixed scripts and lexical checks do not establish broad relevance or reaction.
families.human_review: Required for semantic conclusions from transcripts.
families.health: Useful but claim boundary needs continued discipline.
families.rationale: Provides unique scripted temporal depth that short playability runs lack.

families.name: N1 synthetic scenario-spine lane
families.purpose: Verify deterministic branch fingerprints, divergence, and synthetic state-channel contracts.
families.evidence: fingerprints, reason codes, branch summaries, JSON
families.pass_meaning: Synthetic branch and state invariants are reproducible.
families.fail_meaning: Harness, fixture, or deterministic contract diverged.
families.reliability_issues: Name proximity to scenario spine can overstate production-runtime coverage.
families.evidence_standard: No, unless used to claim behavior.
families.rationale: Preserve deterministic branch contracts inside the general synthetic-session authority rather than a parallel product-validation lane.
families.surviving_authority: SYNTHETIC_SESSIONS for harness contracts; SCENARIO_SPINE for production runtime branches.
families.evidence_loss_risk: Branch divergence fingerprints may be lost if fixtures are removed without migration.

families.name: Synthetic session and transcript regressions
families.purpose: Exercise deterministic generated/fixed actions, progress, routing, and selected state invariants.
families.approximate_case_count: Dozens to hundreds across harness regressions
families.runtime_path: Direct harness/domain or controlled API-shaped paths
families.test_doubles: fake GM, generated profiles, temporary state
families.fail_meaning: Harness, fixture, or selected continuity/state contract diverged.
families.gates: Should gate harness consumers, not semantic quality
families.reliability_issues: Synthetic success is sometimes described too broadly.
families.rationale: Retain utility while explicitly removing product-semantic authority.

families.name: Offline behavioral gauntlet
families.purpose: Detect bounded neutrality, escalation, re-engagement, and dialogue anti-patterns in supplied rows.
families.pass_meaning: Enumerated shallow anti-patterns were not detected; broad semantic correctness is not established.
families.gates: No independent runtime or semantic gate
families.reliability_issues: Empty/short inputs can pass and transcript origin is unauthenticated.
families.human_review: Required before treating findings as semantic verdicts.
families.evidence_standard: Yes if used in a behavioral claim.
families.health: Diagnostic authority implemented; all axes and reason codes remain intact.
families.rationale: Keep useful rules as diagnostic features under calibrated semantic evaluation, not a separate authority.
families.surviving_authority: SEMANTIC_CALIBRATION for evaluator meaning and human-reviewed boundaries.
families.evidence_loss_risk: Specific escalation/re-engagement reason codes could disappear unless migrated as named diagnostics.
families.implementation_notes: Current docs place the gauntlet beneath semantic calibration; evaluator execution and cases are unchanged.
families.audit_recommendation: CONSOLIDATE diagnostic claims under semantic calibration at HIGH confidence; destructive consolidation deferred.

families.name: Human-reviewed manual gauntlets
families.purpose: Collect real local play transcripts and explicit human rubric judgments.
families.runtime_path: Real local chat pipeline and persisted state
families.evidence: full transcript, summary, events, snippets, aggregate report
families.pass_meaning: A named reviewer judged one run against the rubric.
families.fail_meaning: A reviewer judged one run unacceptable or execution failed.
families.gates: Should gate high-consequence player-facing campaign closure when required
families.reliability_issues: Freeform verdict is not independently rubric-validated; execution is not enforced.
families.health: Strongest semantic authority, but operationally sparse.
families.rationale: Human judgment remains necessary where automated semantic evaluators are demonstrably imperfect.

families.name: Semantic calibration corpus
families.purpose: Measure evaluator behavior against explicit human-reviewed boundary cases.
families.pass_meaning: Evaluator behavior matches current corpus expectations.
families.fail_meaning: Evaluator semantics or corpus contract diverged.
families.ci_status: Focused tests; not a product-quality aggregate
families.reliability_issues: Corpus remains small and lacks player-to-GM and generalized ambiguity concepts.
families.human_review: Required for labels and policy boundaries.
families.health: Healthy calibration mechanism with known concept gaps.
families.rationale: It calibrates authority rather than pretending to establish whole-product quality.

families.name: Reactive and adversarial simulated players
families.purpose: Generate output-conditioned, stress-oriented runtime interactions and expose evaluator disagreements.
families.approximate_case_count: Small scenario catalog plus harness tests
families.evidence: full transcripts, decisions, evaluator results, human-review record
families.pass_meaning: Run/evidence contract completed; evaluator verdict remains non-authoritative where disputed.
families.fail_meaning: Runtime, strategy, evidence, or evaluated behavior failed its scoped contract.
families.ci_status: Harness tests only; campaign-operated live runs
families.gates: Evidence requirement for suitable player-facing campaigns
families.reliability_issues: Stress players are deliberately unlike ordinary humans; human-realism authority is absent.
families.human_review: Required for semantic disagreements and representative claims.
families.health: Healthy evidence generator; not a sole judge.
families.rationale: Unique output-conditioned and adversarial coverage complements scripted lanes.

families.name: Content schema/reference/graph lint
families.purpose: Check author-time scene/world content structure and references.
families.pass_meaning: No configured lint errors; warnings depend on invocation.
families.fail_meaning: A content rule found an error or warning policy was enabled.
families.ci_status: Phase-1 finding is currently continue-on-error; warning gate disabled
families.gates: Does not reliably block CI today
families.reliability_issues: Workflow green does not imply lint clean.
families.health: Useful rules with underpowered CI authority.
families.rationale: Preserve lint semantics and later align CI authority with current content requirements.
families.preserved_purpose: Static schema, reference, and graph integrity for authored content.

families.name: Architecture, registry, provenance, and readiness governance
families.purpose: Enforce declared topology, registries, manifests, provenance, and architecture policies.
families.runtime_path: Static source, registries, manifests, and generated reports
families.pass_meaning: Declared repository policy and snapshots agree.
families.fail_meaning: Architecture violation, registry drift, stale snapshot, or obsolete governance expectation.
families.reliability_issues: Current suite mixes authoritative boundaries with administrative snapshots and historical closeout requirements.
families.evidence_standard: No, except provenance for behavioral evidence.
families.health: Multiple current drift failures; authority is not consistently encoded.
families.rationale: Keep intentional architecture contracts while separating release boundaries from generated administrative parity.
families.preserved_purpose: Current architecture boundaries, registry ownership, and evidence provenance.

families.name: Ownership, import-boundary, and write-path governance
families.purpose: Protect deliberate authority facades and production write ownership.
families.approximate_case_count: Dozens of scans and parity assertions
families.pass_meaning: Scanned paths obey declared owner/facade policy.
families.fail_meaning: Current source bypasses a declared boundary or registry is stale.
families.reliability_issues: Some allowlists may encode transitional compatibility topology.
families.human_review: Required where desired boundary is uncertain.
families.health: Several concrete current violations plus possible stale rules.
families.rationale: Do not waive violations or repair blindly until post-reconciliation facade policy is reaffirmed.
families.unresolved_question: Which flagged facades/write owners remain intentional Product Realization boundaries versus compatibility-era migration rules?

families.name: Historical generated closeout-document assertions
families.purpose: Require specific campaign closeout files and historical prose/path declarations.
families.approximate_case_count: 2 canonical provenance checks; 16 historical prose/path nodes retired
families.runtime_path: Canonical audit manifest and closeout locations
families.evidence: canonical closeouts, audit manifest, and retirement ledger
families.fail_meaning: Canonical historical provenance was removed or lost from the audit manifest.
families.ci_status: Narrow provenance checks remain; obsolete prose/path locks retired
families.gates: Does not claim current product correctness
families.reliability_issues: None known after narrowing to canonical provenance.
families.health: Implemented; canonical closeouts remain under docs/audits/closeouts.
families.rationale: Preserve historical provenance in canonical audit locations, but stop making legacy closeout prose a current release condition.
families.evidence_loss_risk: No unique evidence was removed; only executable assertions were retired. Canonical closeouts, discovery records, manifest entries, and trend artifacts remain.
families.recovery: Restore retired assertion nodes from version history using the retirement ledger.
families.implementation_notes: Sixteen historical nodes were replaced by two narrow canonical provenance checks.
families.audit_recommendation: RETIRE active release authority at HIGH confidence.

families.name: Validation Evidence Standard
families.purpose: Package inspectable behavioral claims with transcripts, evaluator results, provenance, disagreements, and limits.
families.invocation: Evidence packet builder and focused pytest
families.pass_meaning: Evidence packet is complete, provenance-preserving, and claim-bounded.
families.fail_meaning: Behavioral evidence packaging is incomplete or inconsistent.
families.reliability_issues: Cannot improve weak source evidence or decide semantic truth.
families.rationale: Provides unique inspectability/provenance without claiming product correctness.

families.name: Review Handoff Automation
families.purpose: Deliver a stable human summary and portable provenance-preserving review bundle.
families.runtime_path: Explicit canonical source selection and ZIP generation
families.pass_meaning: Selected review material is safe, complete to contract, and portable.
families.fail_meaning: Review packaging, provenance, safety, or self-contained inspection failed.
families.reliability_issues: Explicit selection can omit conceptually important unrequested material.
families.human_review: Delivers review; does not replace it.
families.rationale: Solves review delivery without creating duplicate validation authority.
